name: tour-ticket-compare
description: Fan-made stadium tour ticket resource with Cloudflare Pages preview and Worker production guidance.

scripts.deploy: node -e "console.error('Refusing to deploy: production is Cloudflare Worker tourticketcompare-live, while this repo currently has only the Pages deploy command committed. See docs/DEPLOYMENT.md.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.deploy:pages:safe: npm run events:validate:prod && wrangler pages deploy public
scripts.events:update: python3 scripts/csv-to-events.py && python3 scripts/validate-events.py && python3 scripts/partition-events.py && python3 scripts/sync-events-data.py
